observations: make_payload creates a timestamp, subject tag, 96 random bits and HMAC per issuance; no deterministic repeated challenge expected.
Backend check_payload authenticates subject and expiration but explicitly permits same-subject replay within 15 minutes; frontend intent consumption is separate from server proof verification.
Vendored SDK validates proof.payload as string and copies it unchanged into connectItems.tonProof.proof.payload before publishing wallet status.
Exact payload attribution plus no-store GET and per-page issued challenge rejection prevents an old status consuming a newly requested intent with a reused challenge.
not_claimed: No server nonce consumption/storage or cryptographic verifier changes.
